verdict.rationale: Alma is an immigration law firm with a technology-enabled case portal, not a coding agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question and the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows an MCP server, API, or agent-connection endpoint: the OpenAPI probes all returned 404, and the only machine-readable asset is an llms.txt file. The "agent" mentions refer to a legal U.S. Agent petitioner, which is unrelated to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
